launches.title: Callbook AI: The AI collections agency for late stage portfolios

launches.body:
We are a collections agency entirely run by AI.

We have found out that the most effective way to collect a portfolio is by first doing a deep research to locate and understand each person´s situation, and then negotiate with them. 

As a result, we've consistently outperformed every competing collection solutions.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rwVW4nApj1E>

Today, we’re negotiating with 100K+ people every week. We’ve delivered historic recovery at every company we’ve worked with and won 100% of our head-to-head pilots against competing solutions.

Founders **Diego** and **Daniel** bring experience across machine learning and B2B products. Diego has published two peer-reviewed papers on on-device deep learning and TinyML with Elsevier, has 6+ years of experience in embedded ML, and previously built Audi’s e-commerce platform at CI&T. Daniel, former CPO and founder at Treble (YC S19), has 5+ years of experience building and leading B2B products.

**Our ask**

If you know a lender (bank, fintech, BNPL, retailer, insurer). We’d love an intro. sales@callbook.ai
